name: Wikimedia Commons

evidence.quote: This will list information supplied by the uploader, including the copyright status, the copyright owner, and the license conditions.
Media licensed exclusively under non-commercial only licenses (like CC BY-NC-SA) are not accepted either.
some licenses require that the specific license be identified when reusing (including, in some cases, stating or linking to the terms of the license)
commercial use of images of people may require the explicit agreement of the subject, and not just the agreement of the image creator
Directly using a Commons file via embedding its URL ("hotlinking") is also possible, but is not recommended.
GFDL is not permitted as the only acceptable license where all of the following are true: The content was licensed on or after 15 October 2018.

notes: Checked against Commons:Licensing and Commons:Reusing content outside Wikimedia. Each file states its own licence and credit on its description page. Commons doesn't accept NonCommercial-only files, so most files allow commercial use, but each file still needs its own check before an app shows it: its licence (CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA, with its version), the author and credit line it asks for, and any notice about trademarks or identifiable people. A file offered only under the GFDL (Commons still holds older ones) needs its own review: the GFDL's terms weren't checked here. Commons allows hotlinking but advises against it. Until a file is checked, an app links to it. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
